method: two-factor convex blend of the base (r32) weights and solver solution o29 inside the declared mask: torso-region vertices alpha=0.25, pelvis+leg-region vertices alpha=0.25, top-4 pruned and renormalised
selection_basis: largest zero-regression combination from a 21x21 scan against every comparator tolerance (region min/max, p01, p99, volume) versus pinned R2 (excluding the 5 inherited items) and versus r32, evaluated with the exact numpy LBS model (reconstruction error < 1e-6)
inputs: this candidate's own ORIGINAL v1 mesh/weights and the v4 rig only
symmetrised: mirror-averaged after pruning; twin L1 max 2.52e-16
